verdict.rationale: The docs say you can describe a support flow in natural language that combines policies, knowledge and tool connections, and the Internal Agent builds it. Tools can call any API and run against live tickets. This implies the Customer Agent can follow configured multi-step flows rather than return a single canned reply. Nothing in the pack says the agent asks customers clarifying questions or runs iterative troubleshooting. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of the agent asking clarifying questions, documented multi-turn troubleshooting behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration of resolution quality.
